answer: A payout is split so that 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The gale schedule is applied in yarrow and relic makes public each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1898 identities would post 1212 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
